title: Arborg and District Multicultural Heritage Village

services.name: Village Tours
services.desc: The Heritage Village Campground is situated on the west side of the Village, a mere stones throw away from the Town of Arborg and 10 minutes from Lake Winnipeg. The grounds offer travelers 22 serviced campsites (water & electric), picnic tables and fire pits. The campground also has toilets, showers, and a dumpsite. A scenic walking bridge connects the Village to the Town of Arborg. Take a tour through the historic village, walk uptown to shop, go for a swim at the Access Aquatic Centre, or spend the day at Lake Winnipeg or Hecla Island . Sites are first come, first serve. While we appreciate knowing you are coming, reservations are not generally accepted. We strive to accommodate all
